dict.string: Grid saves documents you ask for (PDFs, Word files) to Downloads, and reads files there when you let it.
Grid opens projects and reads or saves files in Documents when you let it.
Grid opens projects and reads or saves files on your Desktop when you let it.
Grid opens projects on external drives when you choose them.
Grid opens and switches between apps when you ask it to use them.
Grid opens projects on network drives when you choose them.
